简体中文: 立即切换编辑器界面语言，重启后恢复此选择。
English: Change the editor language immediately. Your choice is restored on restart.

简体中文: 有 {count} 项未保存修改，是否保存后关闭？
工程目录或 editor-project.json 清单
创建空工程，不附带场景、模型或预设。
English: Create an empty project with no scenes, models, or presets.

简体中文: 新建工程的父目录；初始值为 ~/feathrise。已有工程不会移动。
English: New projects are created here. The default is ~/feathrise.

简体中文: 有 {count} 项未保存修改，是否保存后退出？
默认导出到工程文件夹的 output。导出使用已保存的场景、资产和源码；未保存草稿请先通过原保存入口保存。
English: Exports go to the project output directory by default. Save your changes before exporting. The export uses the saved scenes, assets, and source code.

简体中文: 跨场景共用的 PBR 材质；选中后在下方新建场景层。
English: PBR materials shared across scenes. Select one to create a scene layer below.

简体中文: 地表预设 · 等待目录
选择预设后显式新建场景层；新建或编辑预设在中央标签完成
English: Select a preset and create a scene layer. Create or edit presets in the center tabs.

简体中文: 晴天基准值 · 实际摆幅随天气变化
English: Clear-weather baseline · Actual range varies with weather
Select a file on the left
Waiting for target to be locked

简体中文: 动态场景监控 [F4] · 0.5s刷新 · 选择分页查看
English: Dynamic Scene Monitor [F4] · Refreshes every 0.5 s · Select a tab

简体中文: 水域对象 · 等待场景作者数据
English: Water Objects · Waiting for scene data

水体预设 · 等待目录
等待水体预设编辑标签
English: Waiting for a Water Preset Tab

简体中文: 所有场景共用；编辑或删除预设不等于删除当前场景图层。
English: Shared by all scenes. Editing or deleting presets does not remove layers from this scene.

简体中文: 场景对象：等待场景草稿\n第 1/1 页
English: Scene Objects: Waiting for scene draft\nPage 1/1

简体中文: 区域边界：等待场景作者数据
English: Region Bounds: Waiting for scene data

简体中文: 当前：普通选择 · 印章 0°
请选择场景树中的资产实例
English: Select an asset instance in the scene tree

简体中文: 建筑预设 · 等待目录
请输入场景名称，可填写备注
English: Enter a scene name and optional notes

简体中文: 当前正在编辑预设，切回场景标签查看场景树。
English: A preset is open. Switch to the scene tab to view the scene tree.

简体中文: 空文档，点击“编辑”开始编写
English: Empty document. Select Edit to start writing.

简体中文: 当前场景有未保存修改
English: The current scene has unsaved changes

简体中文: 尚未进入场景\n从场景目录进入场景，或从顶部工具打开预设库
English: No scene loaded\nOpen a scene from the catalog or open the preset library from the toolbar.

简体中文: 选择对象或目录后进行管理
English: Select an object or folder to manage it

简体中文: 着色/三角线：可塑形网格；碰撞：实际物理线条
English: Shaded/Wireframe: editable mesh. Collision: physics geometry.

简体中文: 请选择场景树中的Blender网格
English: Select a Blender mesh in the scene tree

简体中文: 当前场景传送点 · 等待作者数据
English: Scene Portals · Waiting for scene data

简体中文: 目标场景落点 · 尚未选择场景
English: Destination Point · Select a target scene

简体中文: 请先在场景页高亮目标场景，再选择到达点
English: Highlight a destination scene in Scenes, then choose an arrival point

简体中文: 当前网格：尚未选择 · 从左侧场景树选择
English: Current Mesh: None · Select one in the scene tree

简体中文: 当前：选择 · 预备 抬高
等待当前场景作者数据
地形草稿尚未保存，请选择保留哪一版。
English: There are unsaved terrain changes. Choose which version to keep.

简体中文: 高度地形高度不受初始规格限制；体素地形高为初始实心盒高。网格使用资产几何。
English: Height terrain is not limited by its initial height. Voxel terrain height is the initial solid box height. Meshes use their asset geometry.

简体中文: 当前场景暂无独立网格。
English: This scene has no separate meshes.

简体中文: 双击文本文件打开；右键显示文件操作
English: Double-click a text file to open it. Right-click for file actions.

简体中文: 地表作者层 · 等待场景
拖入工程文件夹即可打开
当前场景设为启动场景
English: Use Current Scene as Startup Scene

简体中文: 固定工程最多保留 {count} 项
English: You can pin up to {count} projects

简体中文: 基于 Bevy 的通用 3D 编辑器。
English: A general-purpose 3D editor built with Bevy.

简体中文: 在统一工作台中创建工程、编辑场景，并预览与运行。
English: Create projects, edit scenes, and preview or run them from one workspace.

简体中文: 尚未安装作者插件。选择当前平台的单个插件文件。
English: No authoring plugins are installed. Select a plugin file for this platform.

简体中文: 这里只管理编辑器作者插件。工程运行能力仍需接入对应依赖；启停和移除保留作者数据。
English: Manage authoring plugins here. Add the corresponding dependencies for project runtime features. Disabling or removing a plugin preserves authoring data.

简体中文: 还没有编译诊断。保存源码后将自动后台编译。
English: No build diagnostics. Saving source files starts a background build.

简体中文: 点击诊断位置在中央源码定位；完整输出可在日志中选择复制。
English: Select a diagnostic location to jump to it in the source editor. Copy the full output from the log.

简体中文: 按 Ctrl+Shift+F 打开内容搜索。输入文字后按Enter搜索；文件类型可填json、rs或*.wgsl，留空搜索全部受支持文本。点击结果在内置编辑器定位；外部打开使用磁盘版本，“打开工程”会同时打开工程目录。直接引用检查config/scenes JSON和当前工程的 Rust 源码中的完整路径，JSON优先使用草稿；不判断运行分支、拼接路径、预设ID或模型内部依赖，0处不代表未使用。缺失检查只核对明确路径的物理文件，子资源检查其来源文件。
English: Press Ctrl+Shift+F to open content search. Type a query and press Enter. Enter a type such as json, rs, or *.wgsl, or leave it blank to search all supported text. Select a result to jump to it in the editor. External editors open the saved file. Open Project also opens the project directory. The reference check looks for full paths in config/scenes JSON and project Rust files, using JSON drafts when available. It does not resolve runtime branches, composed paths, preset IDs, or model dependencies. Zero matches does not prove an asset is unused. The missing asset check looks for explicit paths and checks the source file for sub-assets.

简体中文: 搜索完成后输入替换文字，打开中央预览；空文字表示删除。先更新并核对差异，再替换当前匹配、当前文件或勾选文件。操作只改草稿，写盘使用保存本批或保存全部草稿。达到搜索上限时只处理已列出的匹配，未列出内容保持。
English: Enter replacement text after searching and open the center preview. Leave the replacement blank to delete matches. Update and review the diff before replacing this match, the current file, or checked files. Changes stay in drafts until you save the batch or all drafts. If the result limit is reached, only listed matches are included.

简体中文: 预览与编辑共用当前文件草稿。Ctrl+S保存当前文件，Ctrl+Shift+S保存全部草稿；重新载入前会保护未保存内容。Ctrl+F查找字面文字，Enter查找下一处，Shift+Enter查找上一处，可限制大小写、全词或当前选区。Ctrl+H替换只改草稿；Ctrl+G输入从1开始的逻辑行号后按Enter跳转，Esc关闭导航。加载、校验、保存结果和错误见底栏详情。
English: Preview and Edit share the current draft. Ctrl+S saves this file and Ctrl+Shift+S saves all drafts. Reload protects unsaved work. Ctrl+F finds literal text. Enter finds the next match and Shift+Enter finds the previous match. You can limit the search by case, whole words, or selection. Ctrl+H replaces text in the draft. Ctrl+G jumps to a line number starting at 1. Esc closes navigation. Check the status bar for load, validation, and save details.

简体中文: 文档已在中央工作区展开。选择其他文档后，可用此按钮追加中央标签；已有文件的草稿和滚动位置继续保留。
English: This document is open in the workspace. Select another document and use this button to open it in a new tab. Existing drafts and scroll positions are retained.

简体中文: 显示名称 · 支持中文
点击或拖动轮廓可定位正文，视区框表示当前可见范围；不会修改源码。轮廓生成和失败信息见底栏详情。
English: Click or drag the outline to navigate. The box marks the visible range. Source text is unaffected. See status details for outline progress and errors.

简体中文: 选择预设后可应用到当前静水体；新建或编辑在中央打开完整波浪标签。全局预设编辑与场景水域对象是不同的编辑对象。
English: Select a preset to apply it to the current still water body. Create or edit a preset in the center workspace. Global presets and scene water bodies are separate authoring objects.

简体中文: 选择模式只读；工具页只准备类别，进入视口编辑模式后绘制。静水用笔刷绘制R8覆盖，Shift擦除；水位不自动修改河床。\n河流/瀑布：顶视或透视左键空白逐点，拖点只改XZ并保留Y；连接端点高度由系统决定。瀑布正式保存需要不同且有效的源/目标，终点低于起点。\n专业数值框支持左拖实际值、右拖灵敏度、中键精确输入。
English: Select mode is read-only. Pick a category here, then enter viewport Edit mode to draw. Paint R8 coverage for still water and hold Shift to erase. Water level does not reshape the riverbed.\nRivers and waterfalls: click empty space in top or perspective view to add points. Dragging moves X/Z and keeps Y. Connected endpoint heights are resolved automatically. Saving a waterfall requires two distinct valid endpoints, with the destination below the source.\nDrag a numeric field with the left button to adjust its value, right-drag for sensitivity, or middle-click for precise input.

简体中文: 右键旋转 · 中键平移 · 滚轮缩放；复用当前天空与光照，世界内容仅河面和河床。
English: Right-drag to orbit, middle-drag to pan, scroll to zoom. The preview uses the current sky and lighting, and shows the river and riverbed.

简体中文: 使用已有预设：在全局库选择。新建预设：先在左侧资产选择GLB，再点击新建。预设库与当前场景图层是不同的编辑对象。
English: Choose an existing preset from the global library. To create one, choose a GLB in Assets and click New. The preset library and layers on the current scene are separate authoring objects.

简体中文:
绘制：在全局库选预设 → 用此预设新建空白层 → 切到视口编辑后涂绘；新建不会自动填满，Shift+左键擦除。
选层：选择模式左键选择整层；植被工具用Ctrl+左键吸取图层，重复点击或Alt+点击轮换重叠层。复制、删除仅影响当前场景作者层；全局预设删除仍检查所有场景引用。
分组：组内可共存、共享容量或高优先级覆盖；跨组可取最大、相加封顶或非零替换。组容量与覆盖阈值仅在对应规则下可编辑。
数值：左拖实时回显，松开形成一次撤销；中键精确输入，右拖只调本字段灵敏度。
预览：作者源、最终结果与组内冲突使用原覆盖图；编译和密度发布完成不代表GPU与模型已经显示。半径和强度仍在视图同排工具条。
English:
Painting: select a global preset, create an empty layer with it, then paint in viewport Edit mode. New layers start empty. Hold Shift and left-click to erase.
Selecting: click a layer in Select mode, or Ctrl-click with the vegetation tool to sample it. Click again or Alt-click to cycle overlapping layers. Duplicating or deleting affects the selected scene layer. Deleting a global preset checks references across scenes.
Groups: layers within a group can coexist, share capacity, or let higher priority take precedence. Across groups, use maximum, capped addition, or nonzero replacement. Capacity and override thresholds are editable only for their corresponding rules.
Values: left-drag previews the value and creates one undo step on release. Middle-click for precise input and right-drag to adjust the field sensitivity.
Preview modes use the original coverage scene for authoring input, final output, and group conflicts. Published density does not confirm GPU or model visibility. Radius and strength are on the viewport toolbar.

简体中文: 只编辑当前距离档的当前部件
English: Edit only the current part at this distance tier

简体中文: 角色及高度权重独立于部件增删
English: Part type and height weight are independent of adding or removing parts

简体中文: 框选场景中的房屋与装饰，再保存为可重复盖印的院落；也可选择已有院落预设进行盖印。
English: Box-select buildings and props on the scene to save a reusable courtyard, or select an existing preset to stamp it.

简体中文: 盖印时旋转印章，否则旋转选中院落。成员仍可单独调整，不执行整组整平。
English: Rotate the stamp while stamping, or rotate the selected courtyard. Members remain individually editable. Group rotation does not level terrain.

简体中文: 在父场景调整子场景引用的整体位置与朝向；内部内容请打开源场景编辑。复制或移除只操作当前引用，不修改源场景内容。
English: Adjust a subscene reference's position and orientation in its parent scene. Open the source scene to edit its contents. Duplicating or removing a reference affects only that instance.

简体中文: 将目录所选场景添加为子场景
在左侧资产页选择文件，切到编辑模式后在中央场景点击摆放；落点沿用精确地面查询。摆放参数在视口工具条。选择已有实例后，在右侧属性中调整变换、复制或删除，资产选择独立保留。
English: Select a file in Assets, enter Edit mode, and click the scene to place it. Placement uses precise ground queries. Adjust placement on the viewport toolbar. Select an instance to edit its transform, duplicate it, or remove it in the Inspector. Asset selection is tracked separately.

简体中文: 先选择或新建空气墙，切到编辑模式后拖控制点，Ctrl点击线段插点。开放墙左键继续加点，Delete删除明确选中的点。外框必须闭合，内部墙可开放或闭合。重画只影响所选墙。
English: Select or create a wall. In Edit mode, drag its points or Ctrl-click a segment to insert a point. Left-click to extend an open wall, or press Delete to remove selected points. Outer walls must be closed. Interior walls can be open or closed. Redraw applies to the selected wall.

简体中文: 当前源点用于查看、改名或删除；目标落点只用于新建传送点，不修改已有连接或自动生成回程。
English: Select a source point to view, rename, or delete it. The destination point is used when creating a portal. Existing links and return trips are edited separately.

简体中文: 媒体预览已在中央展开。打开所选媒体会追加独立文件标签；返回侧栏会保留当前观察状态。选择文档可另开中央文件页，不替换已有图片或模型。
English: Media is open in the workspace. Opening another asset adds a file tab. Return to the sidebar to resume its view. Documents open in separate tabs.

简体中文: 拖动进度试听片段；试听音量叠加全局音量。播放和停止只影响当前文件，切换文件或离开预览不会自动播放。
English: Drag the playhead to audition a section. Preview volume combines with global volume. Play and Stop affect the current file. Changing files or leaving the preview stops autoplay.

简体中文: 数值框支持左拖实际值、右拖本字段灵敏度、中键精确输入。普通资产使用世界变换，三维地形使用关联Clipmap的源局部变换；位置使用米，缩放为无量纲倍率。
English: Left-drag numeric fields to adjust, right-drag for sensitivity, or middle-click for precise input. Assets use world transforms. 3D terrain uses the source-local transform of its Clipmap. Positions are in meters and scale is unitless.

简体中文: 吸附地面会等待中央视口单击，并按首次摆放规则命中真实地形。跟随地形会归零离地偏移；固定高度保留模式并采用命中Y。
English: Snap to Ground waits for a viewport click and uses the same terrain query as placement. Follow Terrain resets the ground offset. Fixed Height uses the hit Y value and keeps the current mode.

简体中文: 立方体尺寸按局部 X/Y/Z 轴使用米，最小 1 毫米，与三轴缩放独立。外部模型的三维地形与洞口使用其原作者源，按当前对象能力显示。
English: Cube dimensions are local X/Y/Z meters with a 1 mm minimum. Axis scales are separate. External models use their original authoring sources for 3D terrain and openings where supported.

简体中文: 颜色使用 sRGB 的 0–255，粗糙度使用 0–1；属性随场景保存，单次编辑可统一撤销。
English: Colors use sRGB 0–255 and roughness uses 0–1. Properties are saved with the scene. Undo reverses each edit as one operation.

简体中文: 参数立方体使用盒碰撞；点边面编辑后的网格使用实际三角碰撞。按钮选中表示开启；隐藏或删除对象时暂停，恢复后按原开启状态生效。
English: Parametric cubes use box collision. Vertex, edge, or face edits use mesh collision. The highlighted button means enabled. Hiding or removing the object suspends collision until it is restored.

简体中文: 选择建筑预设后开始摆放；新建预设先在左侧资产选择GLB/GLTF。红色预览不可落点。单栋整平开启后会修改地形，并与建筑共用一次撤销。选择已有建筑后，在右侧属性中移动、复制或删除。
English: Select a building preset to place it. To create a preset, first select a GLB or GLTF in Assets. A red preview means placement is blocked. Level Terrain changes the terrain and shares an undo step with the building. Select an existing building to move, duplicate, or delete it in the Inspector.

简体中文: 当前场景 · 持久参数
此区写入当前动态场景。太阳、月光未启用覆盖的属性跟随全局默认；固定场景没有动态场景环境草稿。来源和实际计算值仍在相应字段中显示。
English: These settings belong to the current dynamic scene. Sun and moon properties inherit global values unless overridden. Static scenes have no dynamic scene environment draft. Fields show the source and computed value.

简体中文: 世界调试 · 当前运行
时刻、月份与天气覆盖只调整当前运行。时间暂停及晴天草尖基准摆幅沿用全局设置保存，不写入当前场景环境参数。
English: Time, month, and weather overrides apply to the current run. Paused time and clear-weather grass tip motion are saved in global settings.

简体中文: 全局默认 · 所有动态场景
场景未启用覆盖的属性跟随此处。全局草稿与场景草稿由顶部保存统一提交。
English: Scene properties inherit these settings unless overridden. The top toolbar Save action commits global and scene drafts together.

简体中文: 点选骨节，用移动轴或旋转环摆姿势。自动插帧在松开时记录；关闭后需插入姿势或还原。时间轴滚轮缩放，中键或Shift滚轮平移；空白拖动框选，Ctrl增减选区，拖菱形整组移动。悬停时间轴可用Delete、Ctrl+C/V/Z、空格；Esc取消拖动。旋转数值为XYZ角度，中键精确输入。密集关键帧显示为窄条，放大后可逐键选择。中央动画标签保持打开，在资产列表选择同骨架角色GLB后绑定；模型只用于预览，保存仅写当前动画GLB。外置GLTF只读。
English: Select a bone and pose it with the translation gizmo or rotation rings. Auto Key records on release. When disabled, insert or restore the pose manually. Scroll over the timeline to zoom. Pan with middle drag or Shift+scroll. Drag empty space to box select, use Ctrl to change the selection, and drag a diamond to move the selection. With the pointer over the timeline, use Delete, Ctrl+C/V/Z, or Space. Esc cancels a drag. Rotation uses XYZ degrees. Middle-click for precise input. Dense keys appear as bands. Zoom in to select individual keys. Keep the animation tab open and bind a character GLB with the same skeleton from Assets. The model is for preview. Save writes the current animation GLB. External GLTF files are read-only.

简体中文: 当前模块 · 塑形工具
当前模块 · 植被工具
当前模块 · 水域工具
当前模块 · 交互工具
当前模块 · 建筑预设与摆放
更改即时生效并自动保存；完成只关闭面板。快捷键页面点击对应绑定后录入，冲突和录入进度仍在页面内明确显示。
English: Changes apply immediately and save automatically. Done closes this panel. Select a shortcut to enter a new binding. Conflicts and recording progress appear on the Shortcuts tab.

简体中文: Cargo 和 DX 编译期间，空闲约 5 FPS，有操作约 15 FPS。编译结束后恢复日常帧率。
English: During Cargo and DX builds, the editor uses about 5 FPS when idle and 15 FPS during interaction. Your normal frame rate returns when the build ends.

简体中文: 手动与自动均为60%–200%，加减每次5%。自动按窗口尺寸调整，加减可微调自动比例。只影响编辑器界面，不影响运行界面或三维渲染比例。
English: Manual and auto scale range from 60% to 200%, with 5% steps. Auto adapts to the window size. Use + or − to fine-tune it. This changes the editor UI scale only.

简体中文: 开启时按钮高亮；父场景与子场景生效，退出编辑后仍保留。
English: The button is highlighted when enabled. Applies to parent scenes and subscenes, and persists when leaving the editor.

简体中文: 只影响编辑器工具界面；运行界面、场景和模型颜色保持原样。
English: Applies to editor tools. Runtime UI, scene, and model colors retain their own settings.

简体中文: 工具条切换网格、吸附和移动模式，Y切换常开。Ctrl临时反转；左拖调值，中键精确输入，自动保存。建筑连接与90°规则优先；移动模式只改变位置取整基准。
English: Use the toolbar for grid, snapping, and movement mode. Y toggles persistent snapping. Hold Ctrl to invert it temporarily. Drag to adjust values or middle-click for precise input. Changes save automatically. Building connections and 90° rotation rules take priority. Movement mode sets the position rounding reference.

简体中文: 侧栏宽度和显隐自动保存，下次启动恢复。恢复布局只重置两栏偏好，不改变其他设置或场景作者数据。
English: Sidebar widths and visibility are saved and restored on startup. Reset Layout restores sidebar preferences only.

简体中文: 图片：滚轮缩放，左、中、右键拖动平移。模型：滚轮缩放，右键旋转，中键平移。单击文件在右侧查看，双击在中央标签打开；复制引用只复制当前完整身份。
English: Images: scroll to zoom or drag with any mouse button to pan. Models: scroll to zoom, right-drag to orbit, middle-drag to pan. Click a file to preview it on the right or double-click to open a workspace tab. Copy Reference copies the current full asset reference.

简体中文: 当前通用策略用于普通静态GLB、可雕刻网格及建筑外观；Clipmap与体素保留各自的高级分层。显示按屏幕误差选择精度；碰撞独立，按近场区域驻留，32米内保持原始精度。关闭LOD保留原始网格和碰撞，独立对象覆盖也受总开关约束。
English: This policy applies to static GLB files, sculptable meshes, and building visuals. Clipmaps and voxels use their own advanced LOD. Display detail follows screen error. Collision uses a separate near-field policy with original detail within 32 m. Disabling LOD retains the original mesh and collision. The global toggle also gates per-object overrides.

简体中文: 恢复网格 LOD 默认
删除目标 · 请核对身份
直接删除：永久删除场景文件，不可恢复。放入回收站：将文件移到工程的 assets/scenes/.trash/，可人工恢复。
English: Delete Permanently removes scene files. Move to Trash moves them to assets/scenes/.trash/ in the project for manual recovery.

简体中文: 两种方式都会移除场景目录入口；文件夹已不存在时只清理记录。其他场景仍引用它时拒绝删除，必须先关闭该场景标签并等待场景卸载。
English: Both options remove the scene entry. If the directory is missing, only the entry is removed. Scenes referenced by other scenes cannot be deleted. Close its scene tab and wait for the scene to unload first.

简体中文: 待确认 · 尚未启动删除；确认后仍须通过引用与文件校验。
English: Awaiting confirmation. References and files will be checked before deletion.

简体中文: 返回当前目录的上一级。
在缩略图和列表视图间切换。
English: Switch between thumbnails and list view.

简体中文: 查找文件内容，或展开当前的资产引用结果。
English: Search file contents or expand the current asset references.

简体中文: 检查场景和配置引用的资产。再次点击收起结果。
English: Check assets referenced by scenes and configuration files. Click again to collapse the results.

简体中文: 右键文件或文件夹加入收藏。展开后可定位收藏项和检查路径。
English: Right-click a file or folder to add it to Favorites. Expand to locate favorites or check their paths.

简体中文: 查看最近打开的文件和目录。展开后可定位条目或清空记录。
English: View recently opened files and folders. Expand to locate an item or clear the history.

简体中文:
内容搜索按文字查找文件内容，可按文件类型筛选。按 Ctrl+Shift+F 打开，按 Enter 搜索。
缺失检查核对场景和配置引用的资产路径。再次点击可收起结果。
收藏显示已收藏的文件和目录。右键文件或目录可以加入收藏。
最近访问列出近期访问的文件和目录，点击条目可定位。
刷新会重新读取当前目录。
缩略图可在列表和缩略卡片之间切换。
点击文件行或卡片主体查看属性。点击动画文件上的箭头展开片段。
English:
Content Search finds text in files and can filter by file type. Press Ctrl+Shift+F to open it and Enter to search.
Missing Asset Check verifies asset paths referenced by scenes and configuration files. Click again to collapse the results.
Favorites shows bookmarked files and folders. Right-click a file or folder to add it.
Recent Visits lists recently visited files and folders. Click an entry to locate it.
Refresh reloads the current folder.
Thumbnails switches between list and thumbnail views.
Click a file row or card body to view its properties. Click the arrow on an animation file to list its clips.

简体中文: 当前网格 · 当前作者层
用所选预设新建绘制组
绑定当前作者层到绘制组
解除绘制组（保留已画草地）
数值框支持左拖实际值、右拖本字段灵敏度、中键精确输入，左右键单击无动作。UV0要求U沿下游按米递增、V横向0..1；局部水面请回Blender拆分为独立对象。资产浏览器只选择源文件和摆放；网格属性从场景树选择已摆放对象。失效绑定可用取消水体清除；名称不稳定时请在Blender显式命名对象与网格后重新导出。
English: Left-drag numeric fields to adjust, right-drag for sensitivity, or middle-click for precise input. A single left or right click has no effect. UV0 requires U to increase downstream in meters and V to span 0–1 across the water. Separate partial water surfaces into their own Blender objects. Use Assets to select and place source files. Select a placed object in the scene tree to edit mesh properties. Remove Water clears an invalid binding. Name Blender objects and meshes explicitly before exporting if names are unstable.

简体中文: 先选中高度地形和雕刻工具，再点击视口左侧“编辑”图标后左键连续雕刻；选择模式只预备工具。平滑降低局部高差，平坦区域不改变高度；压平以起笔高度为目标。四种工具共用雕刻速度，平滑和压平到达目标后停止，不越过目标。原始GLB保留资产几何。半径、强度和雕刻速度在视口工具条调整。数值左拖实时修改，中键精确输入，右拖只调整本字段灵敏度。
English: Select height terrain and a sculpt tool, then enter viewport Edit mode and hold the left mouse button to sculpt. Select mode only prepares the tool. Smooth reduces local height differences. Flatten targets the height at the start of the stroke. All four tools use the same speed. Smooth and Flatten stop at their target. Original GLB meshes keep their geometry. Adjust radius, strength, and speed in the viewport toolbar. Left-drag numeric fields to preview, middle-click for precise input, or right-drag for sensitivity.

简体中文: Clipmap与体素支持三维塑形。球形造洞穴；方盒做直墙、平底通道；圆柱开井。整平按首个落点高度削高补低。
English: Clipmaps and voxels support 3D sculpting. Use a sphere for caves, a box for straight walls and flat tunnels, or a cylinder for shafts. Leveling cuts and fills to the height of the first hit.

简体中文: 选择预设后新建图层，切到编辑模式绘制；Shift擦除。删除场景图层不会删除全局预设。
English: Select a preset, create a layer, and paint in Edit mode. Hold Shift to erase. Deleting a scene layer leaves its global preset available.

简体中文: 绘制地面的保水倾向，不是设置静水水位，不占地表或植被图层。左键绘制，Shift擦除；屋内、桥下保持零值。选择工具不创建画布，首次有效笔划才创建。切换工具可查看随天气变化的实际水洼。
English: Paint how readily ground retains puddles, separate from still-water height and surface or vegetation layers. Paint with the left button and hold Shift to erase. Leave interiors and areas under bridges at zero. The first valid stroke creates the canvas. Switch tools to see weather-driven puddles.

简体中文: 冲突目标 · 外部版本已变化
放弃地形草稿，重新加载并验证外部地形。
English: Discard the terrain draft and reload and validate the external terrain.

简体中文: 保留当前顶点并覆盖本次检测到的外部版本。外部文件再次变化时必须重新处理冲突，不能沿用旧授权。
English: Keep the current vertices and replace the external revision shown here. A later external change requires a new decision.

简体中文: 原始 GLB · 使用所选资产
支持矩形Clipmap及二次幂格距比例；移动旋转分离后暂停，回到原位恢复。
English: Supports rectangular Clipmaps with power-of-two grid spacing ratios. The stitch pauses when moved or rotated apart and resumes when restored.

简体中文: 工程已关闭，回到开始页
English: Project closed. Returned to the Start page.

简体中文: 已取消，当前工程、草稿和历史保留
English: Canceled. You can continue editing the current project.

简体中文: 正在后台校验工程；当前工程保持打开…
English: Checking the project in the background…

简体中文: 正在准备目标工程工作台；当前工程保持打开…
目标工程已准备，正在交接当前工程…
English: The next project is ready. Switching projects…

简体中文: 目标工程工作台未能打开：{status}；原工程保留
English: Could not open the selected project: {status}. The current project is open.

简体中文: 目标工程准备超时，原工程保留
English: Preparing the selected project timed out

简体中文: 工程已校验，正在确认首页界面偏好已保存…
English: Project verified. Waiting for editor preferences to save…

简体中文: 编辑器个人设置已保存
正在保存默认工程目录…
正在移除最近记录，工程文件保持原样…
正在取消本次准备，当前工程和已发布文件保留
English: Canceling project preparation. The current project and published files are kept.

简体中文: 正在处理当前工程操作，请等待或取消后重试
English: A project operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish or cancel it and try again.

简体中文: 正在检查当前工程的未保存内容…
English: Checking the current project for unsaved changes…

简体中文: 退出确认尚未准备完成，请稍后重试
English: Quit confirmation is still loading. Try again in a moment.

简体中文: 请确认是否退出编辑器
English: Please confirm whether to quit the editor.

简体中文: 正在退出编辑器，等待当前工程和本次任务收口…
English: Quitting the editor once the current project and its tasks finish…

简体中文: 正在退出编辑器，等待本次任务收口…
English: Quitting the editor once background tasks finish…

简体中文: 已取消退出编辑器，当前工作台和准备任务保留
English: Quit canceled. The workspace remains open and project preparation continues.

简体中文: 已返回当前工程，原文档与历史保留
English: Returned to the current project with its documents and edit history.

简体中文: 工程未交接：{error}；已发布的工程文件保留
English: Could not switch projects: {error}. Published project files are kept.

简体中文: 工程工作台异常退出：{status}；工程文件保留，可从最近记录重开
English: The project workspace exited unexpectedly: {status}. You can reopen it from Recent Projects.

简体中文: 请填写有效工程名称，名称中不能包含路径分隔符。
English: Enter a valid project name without path separators.

简体中文: 请选择工程目录或 editor-project.json。
English: Select a project folder or editor-project.json.

简体中文: 请先完成或取消输入法候选。
English: Finish or cancel the input method composition first.

简体中文: 正在按原作者流程保存全部修改…
保存未完成：{error}。当前工程、未保存内容和历史保留。
English: Save incomplete: {error}. The project is open with your drafts and history.

简体中文: 已取消关闭工程，作者草稿和历史保留
已取消退出编辑器，作者草稿和历史保留
构建配置：{profile}（沿用顶栏选择）
导出完成：{files} 个文件，{bytes} 字节{detail}
正在取消导出，等待本次构建和文件事务收口…
English: Canceling export. Waiting for the build and file transaction to finish…

简体中文: 导出已取消，原输出与作者草稿保留
构建完成，正在收集运行文件和已保存资产…
English: Build complete. Collecting runtime files and saved assets…

简体中文: 此操作只保存启动设置；场景草稿请使用原保存按钮。
English: This saves the startup settings. Use the scene Save action for scene drafts.
Select a plugin to view details

简体中文: 全局插件供当前用户的所有工程使用；安装和设置完成后即生效。
English: Global plugins are available to every project for this user. Changes apply when saved.

简体中文: 全局插件供当前用户的所有工程使用；当前工程在重开后采用变更。
English: Global plugins are available to every project for this user. Reopen the project to apply changes.

简体中文: 工程同名插件优先；可单独停用继承的全局插件。安装、更新与移除在重开工程后生效。
English: Project plugins take precedence over global plugins with the same ID. Inherited plugins can be disabled for this project. Reopen the project to apply changes.

简体中文: 撤销当前场景的上一次作者修改，不影响其他文档。
English: Undo the latest edit to the current scene.

简体中文: 恢复当前场景刚撤销的作者修改。
English: Redo the latest undone edit to the current scene.

简体中文: 保存当前场景草稿；预设与资产文档使用各自的保存入口。
English: Save the current scene draft. Presets and asset documents have their own Save actions.

简体中文: 点击骨段或菱形起点，选中要调权的骨骼。
English: Click a bone segment or its diamond to select it for weight editing.

简体中文: 打开当前骨骼的选区、画笔和权重编辑工具。
English: Open vertex selection, brushes, and weight tools for the selected bone.

简体中文: 将当前权重草稿另存为 GLB 副本。
English: Save the current weight draft to a new GLB copy.

简体中文: 撤销当前 GLB 的上一次权重修改。
English: Undo the latest weight edit in the current GLB.

简体中文: 恢复当前 GLB 刚撤销的权重修改。
English: Redo the latest undone weight edit in the current GLB.

简体中文: 源 GLB 已更新，请重新打开权重
English: The source GLB has changed. Reopen the weight editor.

简体中文: 当前权重操作尚未完成
English: The current weight operation is in progress.

简体中文: 当前权重预览尚未就绪
English: The weight preview is still loading.

简体中文: 当前没有待保存的权重修改
English: There are no unsaved weight edits.

简体中文: 当前没有可撤销的权重修改
English: There are no weight edits to undo.

简体中文: 当前没有可重做的权重修改
English: There are no weight edits to redo.

简体中文: 填写场景名称和可选备注，在当前目录创建空白场景。
English: Enter a scene name and optional notes to create an empty scene in the current folder.

简体中文: 收起编辑器并返回当前场景，不自动保存或丢弃草稿。
English: Close the editor and return to the current scene.

简体中文: 恢复自由观察方向；右键旋转，中键平移，滚轮缩放。
English: Restore free view. Right-drag to orbit, middle-drag to pan, or scroll to zoom.

简体中文: 调整界面缩放、配色、布局、吸附及快捷键；不修改作者数据。
English: Adjust editor scale, theme, layout, snapping, and shortcuts.

简体中文: 专注编辑 / 展开两侧
显示或收起左侧内容浏览器，保留首选宽度与未保存草稿。
English: Show or hide the left content browser, retaining its preferred width and drafts.

简体中文: 显示或收起右侧检查器及预览，保留当前选择。
English: Show or hide the Inspector and preview on the right.

简体中文: 预览当前工程的内存草稿；点击预览悬浮工具条的“返回”恢复原作者现场，不会隐式保存。Debug/Release决定工程构建方式。
English: Preview the current project draft. Click Return on the preview toolbar to resume editing. Debug or Release sets the build profile.

简体中文: 在独立窗口运行已保存的工程，编辑器保留未保存的草稿。
English: Run the saved project in a separate window. Unsaved drafts are available when you return.

简体中文: 全局安装和设置完成后即生效；已运行的工程保留原会话。
English: Global changes apply when saved. Running projects continue their current sessions.

简体中文: 变更在重开工程后生效；当前已加载工具继续可用。
English: Reopen the project to apply changes. Loaded tools remain available in this session.

简体中文: 勾选表示参与场景；点击切换。会写入场景，可撤销；锁定时需先解锁。
English: Toggle inclusion in the saved scene. The change is undoable. Unlock the object first if it is locked.

简体中文: 眼睛表示显示，划线表示隐藏；只影响编辑器显示，保留场景参与状态和碰撞。
English: Toggle visibility in the editor. Scene inclusion and collision are separate.

简体中文: 闭锁时禁止修改网格，仍可选中查看；再次点击解锁。
English: Lock the mesh against editing. Locked meshes can still be selected and inspected.

简体中文: 从上方观察当前场景，保留当前位置与投影模式。
English: View the current scene from above, keeping the current position and projection.

简体中文: 切换到前方观察方向，不修改场景或所选对象。
English: Switch to the front view of the current scene.

简体中文: 切换到侧方观察方向，不修改场景或所选对象。
English: Switch to the side view of the current scene.

简体中文: 在正交与透视投影间切换，观察方向保持不变。
English: Toggle orthographic and perspective projection while keeping the view direction.

简体中文: 对准已确认的资产、水体或传送点；不采用候选悬停选择。
English: Frame the selected asset, water body, or portal.

简体中文: 按当前场景边界取景，保留观察方向与投影模式。
English: Frame the current scene while keeping the view direction and projection.

简体中文: 单击选择点、边或面；Shift 增减选择，A 全选。
English: Click to select vertices, edges, or faces. Hold Shift to change the selection. Press A to select all.

简体中文: 选择场景中的对象并查看属性，不落笔修改场景。
English: Select scene objects to inspect their properties.

简体中文: 拖动世界轴或XZ平面手柄移动当前所选对象。
English: Drag an axis or XZ plane handle to move the selected object.

简体中文: 绕世界Y轴旋转所选对象；建筑沿用90°档位。
English: Rotate the selected object around the world Y axis. Buildings rotate in 90° increments.

简体中文: 等比缩放所选普通资产，保持已有三轴比例。
English: Scale the selected asset uniformly, preserving its axis proportions.

简体中文: 展开选择类别与复制、粘贴、删除等对象操作。
English: Show selection categories and object actions such as copy, paste, and delete.

简体中文: 显示真实网格三角边；下拉可开启穿透线框。
English: Show mesh triangle edges. Enable X-ray wireframe from the dropdown.

简体中文: 预览原始材质并使用当前相机专属工作室补光。
English: Preview original materials with studio lighting attached to the current camera.

简体中文: 显示场景原始材质、灯光和环境。
English: Show the scene's materials, lights, and environment.

简体中文: 点击轴端点切到对应正交视图；再次点击已对准的端点翻到反方向。
English: Click an axis endpoint for an orthographic view. Click the aligned endpoint again to flip direction.

简体中文: 在正交与透视间切换，保留当前观察角度和焦点。
English: Toggle orthographic and perspective projection while keeping the view direction and focus.

简体中文: 起点已设置；移动笔刷后设置终点。
English: Start point set. Move the brush to set the end point.

简体中文: 设置起点 → 移动笔刷 → 设置终点 → 执行雕刻。
English: Set the start point, move the brush, then set the end point and sculpt.

简体中文: 这个字段不是资产引用
English: This field is not an asset reference

简体中文: 目标LOD、部件或后端已切换，请重新选择资产
English: The target LOD, part, or backend changed. Select the asset again.

简体中文: 拖动世界轴手柄移动所选点、边或面；G 开始移动，XYZ 约束。
English: Drag an axis handle to move the selected vertices, edges, or faces. Press G to move and X, Y, or Z to constrain.

简体中文: 绕所选元素中心旋转；R 开始旋转，XYZ 约束。单点绕自身中心旋转不改变位置。
English: Rotate around the selection center. Press R to rotate and X, Y, or Z to constrain. A single vertex stays in place.

简体中文: 新建层预设：{id}；等待目录加载，已有正式输出仍按原规则复用。
English: New Layer Preset: {id}. Waiting for the library. Existing output remains available.

简体中文: 新建层预设：沿用“{name}”的正式输出；新建仍为空白画布。
English: The new empty layer will reuse output from “{name}”.

简体中文: 作者图层 · 暂无\n先选预设，再点“新建空白层”。
English: Scene Layers · None\nSelect a preset, then click Create Empty Layer From Preset.

简体中文: 等待当前场景作者数据；全局植被预设仍可管理。
English: Waiting for scene data. Global vegetation presets are available.

简体中文: 正在保存当前场景；等待完整作者事务完成。
正在后台准备当前预设的空白R8画布；完整采用后才新增图层和撤销记录。
English: Preparing the preset's empty R8 canvas. The layer and undo entry appear when it is ready.

简体中文: 当前植被笔划正在进行或收尾；松开后再修改图层结构。
English: Finish the vegetation brush stroke before changing the layer structure.

简体中文: 当前网格尚无植被作者层；可用所选预设创建第一张空白画布。
English: This mesh has no vegetation layers. Create an empty layer with the selected preset.

简体中文: 视口：植被编辑；隐藏、锁定或无有效作者层时，原笔刷继续拒绝落笔。
English: Viewport: Vegetation editing. Paint on a visible, unlocked layer.

简体中文: 视口：未启用植被笔刷；选择模式不落笔，图层按钮及属性仍走原作者事务。
English: Viewport: Vegetation brush inactive. Layer controls are available in Select mode.

简体中文: 编译：等待当前场景植被作者数据。
编译：当前修订失败，保留上一完整正式结果；原因见最近操作。
English: Compile: Failed. The last complete result is still in use. See Recent Actions for details.

简体中文: 编译：作者与正式输出修订{revision}一致；不代表GPU已经显示。
English: Compile: Revision {revision} is ready. Rendering may still be in progress.

简体中文: 编译：笔划期间合并最新修订，松开后再编译完整结果。
English: Compile: The latest changes are compiled when the brush stroke ends.

简体中文: 编译：后台任务处理中；新修订可能仍在等待旧任务归还唯一槽。
English: Compile: Processing in the background. Newer revisions may be queued.

简体中文: 编译：等待当前完整作者修订，继续保留上一完整结果。
English: Compile: Waiting for the latest revision. The previous result is still in use.

简体中文: 预览：等待当前场景植被数据。
预览：当前完整密度已发布；草叶GPU、模型及高度仍按原加载链就绪，空白层不显示植被。
English: Preview: Density is ready. Grass, models, and heights may still be loading. Empty layers have no vegetation.

简体中文: 预览：等待当前完整密度发布；上一版画面不代表本次完成，空白层不显示植被。
English: Preview: Waiting for updated density. The previous result may still be visible. Empty layers have no vegetation.

简体中文: 全局库更新失败：{error}；保留上一完整目录。
English: Global preset library update failed: {error}. Showing the last complete library.

简体中文: 等待当前场景作者数据；请先进入场景
English: Open a scene to load its authoring data.

简体中文: 待摆放资产 · 尚未选择
全局默认未保存 · 使用顶部保存
English: Global defaults have unsaved changes. Use Save in the toolbar.

简体中文: 全局默认无未保存修改
English: Global defaults have no unsaved changes.
Global source is up to date.

简体中文: 等待全局来源同步，暂用安全默认值
English: Using safe defaults while the global source loads.

简体中文: 场景目录 · 详情与操作说明
请在目录中选择场景或文件夹
English: Select a scene or folder in the catalog.

简体中文: 所选对象已不在目录中
English: The selected item is no longer in the catalog.

简体中文: 正在按可见目录顺序连选…
English: Selecting a range in the visible catalog…

简体中文: Ctrl点击增减选择，Shift连续选择；拖动任一选中项整批归类，父目录包含子项时自动去重
English: Ctrl-click to toggle items or Shift-click to select a range. Drag a selected item to move the selection. A selected folder already includes its children.

简体中文: 进入前由原切换场景确认处理未保存修改；当前不能删除场景
English: Resolve unsaved changes before switching scenes. The current scene cannot be deleted yet.

简体中文: 双击场景或点击进入打开；Ctrl多选、Shift连选，拖动批量归类；新建项建在该场景所在目录
English: Double-click a scene or use Enter to open it. Ctrl-click or Shift-click to select multiple items, then drag to move them. New items go in the scene's folder.

简体中文: 点击目录展开或收起；Ctrl多选、Shift连选，拖动可整体移动；新建项建在该目录，只能删除空文件夹
English: Click a folder to expand or collapse it. Ctrl-click or Shift-click to select multiple items, then drag to move them. New items go in this folder. Empty folders can be deleted.

简体中文: 新场景和文件夹建在根目录；目录选择不改变当前场景
English: New scenes and folders go in the root folder. Selecting a folder keeps the current scene open.

简体中文: 代码构建或应用失败 · 完整输出见日志
English: Code build or apply failed · See Project Log

简体中文: 编译完成，可应用并重启预览
English: Build complete · Ready to apply and restart the preview

简体中文: 正在应用新代码并重启预览
English: Applying code and restarting the preview…

简体中文: 正在收口代码构建任务
{count} 条诊断 · 点击位置在中央源码定位；完整输出可在日志中选择复制。
English: Diagnostics: {count} · Click a location to open the source. Copy full output from Project Log.
No source location in this project

简体中文: 构建方式：DX；配置：render-dev；缓存：{path}；启用函数热更新
English: Build tool: DX · Profile: render-dev · Cache: {path} · Hotpatching enabled

简体中文: 构建方式：Cargo；配置：{profile}；缓存：{path}；不启用DX函数热更新
English: Build tool: Cargo · Profile: {profile} · Cache: {path} · DX hotpatching disabled

简体中文: 构建方式：Cargo；配置：{profile}；缓存：{path}；当前组合使用完整编译路径
English: Build tool: Cargo · Profile: {profile} · Cache: {path} · Full rebuild for this configuration

简体中文: 构建方式：{backend}；配置：{profile}；缓存：{path}；完整编译
English: Build tool: {backend} · Profile: {profile} · Cache: {path} · Full build

简体中文: DX 工程构建与产物准备完成，用时 {seconds} 秒
English: DX build and artifact preparation finished in {seconds} s

简体中文: Cargo 工程构建与产物准备完成，用时 {seconds} 秒
English: Cargo build and artifact preparation finished in {seconds} s

简体中文: 未安装函数热更新工具，本次使用完整编译与重启路径
English: The hotpatch tool is unavailable. This run uses a full rebuild and restart.

简体中文: 工程3D编译已停止，后台任务已完整退出
English: Project 3D build stopped. The background task has exited.

简体中文: 已校验合法成员并补齐{count}个 dx 空归档格式头，完整性由本次 fat 发布门核对
English: Restored {count} empty DX archive headers after checking their members. The fat build verifies the output.

简体中文: 正在保存当前场景；等待完整作者事务完成
先在左侧场景树选择网格；空场景可用顶部“网格”创建
English: Select a mesh in the Scene tree or add one with the Mesh tool.

简体中文: 所选网格未参与场景、已隐藏或锁定；恢复后才能塑形
English: To sculpt, select a mesh that is enabled, visible, and unlocked.

简体中文: 所选网格作者数据或变换正在准备；保留上一完整结果
English: Preparing the selected mesh. The last complete result is still visible.

简体中文: 原始 GLB 保留资产几何；当前塑形工具适用于高度地形和体素地形
English: Sculpting is available for height terrain and voxel terrain. GLB assets keep their original geometry.

简体中文: 三维雕刻适用于高度地形和体素地形
English: Volume sculpting requires height terrain or voxel terrain.

简体中文: 三维笔划计算/联合碰撞正在进行；松手后可保存或撤销
English: Processing the volume stroke and collision. Release the mouse to save or undo.
Surface preset library failed to load: {error}

简体中文: 等待全局地表预设目录
English: Waiting for the global surface preset library.

简体中文: 正在删除场景层；保留上一完整地表，完成后可撤销
English: Deleting the scene layer. The previous surface remains visible until completion, when the change can be undone.

简体中文: 正在准备地表作者画布；等待完整结果
地表笔划正在进行或收口；已受理样本按原事务完成
请先选择预设，并显式新建或选中当前场景层
English: Select a preset, then create or select a layer on this scene.

简体中文: 积水笔划正在进行或收口；等待完整作者结果
积水预览正在准备；保留上一完整画面
English: Preparing the puddle preview. The previous result is still visible.

简体中文: 地形画面与碰撞正在准备；保留上一完整结果
English: Preparing terrain rendering and collision. The previous result is still in use.

简体中文: 当前仅选择；点击视口“编辑”后才允许落笔
English: Switch the viewport from Select to Edit to paint.

简体中文: 前视/侧视不接受新笔划；请切换透视或顶视
English: Switch to Perspective or Top view to paint.

简体中文: 精确地形查询失败；未写入作者数据
English: Terrain query failed. No changes were applied.

简体中文: 未命中可编辑地形；未写入作者数据
English: The cursor missed editable terrain. No changes were applied.

简体中文: 等待精确地形落点或作者高度页；不会使用零平面落笔
English: Waiting for terrain heights to place the brush stroke.

简体中文: 场景已加载；仅在有效视口落点上绘制
English: Scene loaded. Paint on a valid surface in the viewport.

简体中文: 选择模式 · 视口不落笔
正在切换场景，作者操作暂不可用
正在保存场景，等待原事务完成
控制点拖动中；请松开后切换工具
English: Release the control point before switching tools.

简体中文: 等待当前场景与作者草稿就绪，不显示旧场景参数。
English: Waiting for the current scene and its draft.

简体中文: 当前场景草稿尚未就绪；世界调试与全局默认仍可使用。
English: Waiting for the scene draft. World Debug and Global Defaults are available.

简体中文: 进入场景后编辑持久参数；空世界仍可调整世界调试与全局默认。
English: Open a scene to edit its saved settings. World Debug and Global Defaults are available.

简体中文: 太阳与月光 · 全局默认
太阳与月光 · 场景覆盖
预览：等待完整密度快照
English: Preview: Waiting for the density snapshot

简体中文: 点击「选择动画」打开活动文件选择窗口。单击文件只在窗口内选中候选，点击文件箭头展开片段列表。选中片段后点击「选择」，在当前模型上播放。点击「取消」或关闭窗口结束选择。
English: Choose Animation opens a floating file picker. Click a file to select a candidate, then click its arrow to list the clips. Select a clip and click Select to play it on the current model. Click Cancel or close the window to end selection.

简体中文: 请在左侧「工程」单击一份带兼容 Mixamo 骨架的动作 GLB。
English: In the Project panel on the left, click an animation GLB with a compatible Mixamo rig.

简体中文: {file} 缺少可用的 Mixamo 人形参考骨架，请从左侧重选。
English: {file} has no compatible Mixamo humanoid rig. Choose another file on the left.

简体中文: 拖动圆点校正关节。点方向球的「前」切换正视，右键旋转查看深度。青色为左侧，橙色为右侧。
English: Drag the markers to adjust joints. Click F on the orientation widget for a front view, or right-drag to orbit. Cyan is left, orange is right.

简体中文: 正在识别人形关节点，可先在左侧「工程」选择参考 GLB。
English: Detecting humanoid joints. You can choose a reference GLB in the Project panel on the left.

简体中文: 从左侧「工程」选择参考骨架，校正关节点后生成绑骨模型。
English: Choose a reference rig in the Project panel on the left, then adjust the joint markers and create the rigged model.

简体中文: 正在本地计算骨骼和蒙皮权重…
English: Calculating the skeleton and skin weights locally…

简体中文: 正在校验并发布新的 GLB…
English: Validating and publishing the new GLB…

简体中文: 已生成 {file} · {joints} 个关节 · {vertices} 个顶点。可选择动作预览。
English: Created {file} · {joints} joints · {vertices} vertices. Select a motion to preview.

简体中文: 未找到带兼容 Mixamo 人形骨架的 GLB 动作。导入参考动作后可重新检查。
English: No animation GLB with a compatible Mixamo humanoid rig was found. Import a reference animation and check again.

简体中文: 绑骨任务已取消，可重新检查。
English: Rigging task cancelled. You can check again.

简体中文: 自动绑骨任务仍在收尾，请等待完成或取消
English: Auto-rigging is still finishing. Wait for it or cancel it.
